```{r}
library(here)

```
working on the raw egg size measurements for each individual egg

AMBIENT, WARM AND HOT LARVAL TEMPERATURE
```{r}
raw_egg_sizes <- read.csv(here("data", "clean data", "raw egg sizes.csv"))

mean(raw_egg_sizes$area)
sd(raw_egg_sizes$area)

raw_egg_sizes %>%
  filter(pupal_treatment == "wild") %>%
  group_by(pupal_treatment) %>%
  summarise(mean_egg_size = mean(area), n = n())


raw_egg_sizes <- raw_egg_sizes %>%
  mutate(grandmotherID = sub("^[^.]*\\.[^.]*\\.([^_]+)_.*$", "\\1", adultID))

#remove this adultID because it doens't have a grandmotherID
raw_egg_sizes <- raw_egg_sizes %>%
  filter(adultID != "CTRL.WTH_P8_W")

#make maternal ID a factor
raw_egg_sizes$grandmotherID <- as.factor(raw_egg_sizes$grandmotherID)

#make clutchID a factor
raw_egg_sizes$motherID <- as.factor(raw_egg_sizes$clutchID)

#convert the pupal temperatures to factors so they plot in the correct order
raw_egg_sizes$pupal_treatment <- factor(raw_egg_sizes$pupal_treatment,
                             levels = c("wild", "ambient", "cool", "mean", "warm", "hot"))

#convert the larval  temperatures to factors so the plot in the correct order
raw_egg_sizes$larval_treatment <- factor(raw_egg_sizes$larval_treatment,
                             levels = c("wild", "ambient", "cool", "mean", "warm", "hot"))

#mean and SD of all egg sizes
summary(raw_egg_sizes$egg_mean_1A)
sd(raw_egg_sizes$egg_mean_1A)


#look at the distributions of egg size
egg_size_distribution <- ggplot(raw_egg_sizes, aes(x = area)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 0.01) +  # change this value to control bin width +
  labs(title = "A) Egg size",
       x = expression(Egg~area~(mm^2)),
       y = "Count") +
  theme_bw()+
    theme(
    text = element_text(size = 18),            # increases all text
    axis.title = element_text(size = 20),      # axis titles bigger
    axis.text = element_text(size = 18),       # axis tick labels bigger
    legend.text = element_text(size = 18),     # legend text bigger
    legend.title = element_text(size = 20))

egg_size_distribution

#looking just at ambient, warm and hot larval temperature - need to remove wild because they don't have weight, or maternal ID or clutchID
egg_sizes_filtered <- raw_egg_sizes %>%
  filter(larval_treatment %in% c("ambient", "warm", "hot")) %>%
  mutate(weight_mg = weight * 1000) %>%
  mutate(weight_mg_centered = weight_mg - mean(weight_mg, na.rm = TRUE))


#mean egg size in each pupal treatment
egg_sizes_filtered %>%
  group_by(pupal_treatment) %>%
  summarise(mean_egg_size = mean(area), n = n())



```


```{r}

egg_size_model <- lmer(area ~ larval_treatment * pupal_treatment + (1|grandmotherID/motherID) + weight_mg_centered, data = egg_sizes_filtered)
summary(egg_size_model)

#use a type III anova because there is an interaction term???
Anova(egg_size_model, type = "III")
```

```{r}
#TO MAKE WORD DOCUMENT OF THE MODEL OUTPUT

# Automatically extract nested random effects and observation counts from egg_size_model
vc <- as.data.frame(VarCorr(egg_size_model))
ngrps <- summary(egg_size_model)$ngrps

re_note <- sprintf(
  "Random effects: motherID:grandmotherID Variance = %.4f, SD = %.4f | grandmotherID Variance = %.4f, SD = %.4f | Residual Variance = %.4f, SD = %.4f (Number of obs: %d, groups: motherID:grandmotherID = %d, grandmotherID = %d).",
  vc$vcov[1], vc$sdcor[1],
  vc$vcov[2], vc$sdcor[2],
  vc$vcov[3], vc$sdcor[3],
  nobs(egg_size_model),
  ngrps["motherID:grandmotherID"],
  ngrps["grandmotherID"]
)

modelsummary(
  list(" " = egg_size_model),
  effects = "fixed",
  estimate = "{estimate}{stars}",
  statistic = c(
    "Std. Error" = "{std.error}",
    "t value"    = "{statistic}",
    "Pr(>|t|)"   = "{p.value}"
  ),
  shape = term ~ model + statistic,
  fmt = 3,
  gof_map = NA,
  title = "Linear mixed model (REML) | Formula: area ~ larval_treatment * pupal_treatment + (1 | grandmotherID/motherID) + weight_mg_centered",
  notes = c(
    re_note,
    "Signif. codes: *** p < 0.001, ** p < 0.01, * p < 0.05, . p < 0.1"
  ),
  output = here("egg_size_model.docx")
)


```




AMBIENT AND WILD COMPARISON
```{r}
ambient_and_wild <- raw_egg_sizes %>%
  filter(pupal_treatment %in% c("wild", "ambient")) %>%
   mutate(
    larval_treatment = factor(larval_treatment, levels = c("ambient", "wild")))

lm1 <- lm(area ~ larval_treatment, data = ambient_and_wild)
summary(lm1)

```


```{r}
#to make a word document of the model summary

s <- summary(lm1)
fstat <- s$fstatistic
f_pval <- pf(fstat["value"], fstat["numdf"], fstat["dendf"], lower.tail = FALSE)

lm_note <- sprintf(
  "Residual standard error: %.3f on %d degrees of freedom | Multiple R-squared: %.4f, Adjusted R-squared: %.4f | F-statistic: %.2f on %d and %d DF, p-value: %.3g",
  s$sigma, s$df[2],
  s$r.squared, s$adj.r.squared,
  fstat["value"], fstat["numdf"], fstat["dendf"], f_pval
)

modelsummary(
  list(" " = lm1),
  estimate = "{estimate}{stars}",
  statistic = c(
    "Std. Error" = "{std.error}",
    "t value"    = "{statistic}",
    "Pr(>|t|)"   = "{p.value}"
  ),
  shape = term ~ model + statistic,
  fmt = 3,
  gof_map = NA,
  title = "Linear model (lm) | Formula: area ~ larval_treatment",
  notes = c(
    lm_note,
    "Signif. codes: *** p < 0.001, ** p < 0.01, * p < 0.05, . p < 0.1"
  ),
  output = here("wild_egg_size_model.docx")
)
```
